annotations.title: Daily market briefing: SEC red flags, earnings, IPOs, macro

description: Answers "What happened in the markets I should know about?", "Give me a morning briefing" or "Anything bad filed about my holdings overnight?". One call combines: SEC alerts filed in the last 24 hours, most serious first (restatements, auditor changes, delisting notices, late filings, cyber incidents, insider purchases of $100K+); earnings releases from the latest day with any, with headline figures; IPO registrations and pricings this week (SPACs left out); and US Treasury yields, CPI, unemployment, payrolls and Fed funds. Give `tickers` to narrow alerts and earnings to a watchlist, or `include` to pick sections. Starts with a few plain-sentence `summary` lines. For one every morning on your webhook, use daily_briefing_subscription. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.025 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

include.description: Sections to include: alerts (SEC red flags and insider buys), earnings, ipos, economy. Default: all four.

tickers.description: A watchlist: SEC alerts and earnings only for these tickers. Default: the whole market.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
